meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: Explore-first planning consultant that writes one decision-complete work plan before coding. Use only on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; it never self-activates on a bare ulw run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把模糊需求梳理成一份可直接开工的工作计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果接到新需求后习惯先理清步骤再动手写代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a vague request into one ready-to-execute work plan before coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you plan out steps before writing any code.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 变成一名规划顾问:只做只读探索、不改产品代码,先产出一份「决策完整」的工作计划并写入 .omo/ 下的计划文件,等你明确同意后才写计划,真正执行由你另开的会话负责。
howto.when: 只有你明确要求走 ulw-plan 流程,或要求在动手前先出一份计划时才接管;单独跑一次 ulw 不会自动触发它。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 给 /login 加限流做个计划
say.note: 先只读探索,再给方案等你拍板

say.text: 把这件事做成计划,先别动代码
say.note: 进入规划模式,不做任何实现

say.text: 这份计划要高精度审查
say.note: 会在计划里标记需要高精度评审

howto.what_en: Turns Claude into a planning consultant: read-only exploration, no product-code edits, one decision-complete work plan written under .omo/ after your explicit okay; execution is a separate session you start.
howto.when_en: Only when you explicitly ask for the ulw-plan workflow or ask for a plan before implementation; a bare ulw run never self-activates it.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to plan a rate limit for /login
say_en.note: read-only exploration, then a plan for your okay

say_en.text: Turn this into a plan, don't touch the code
